REJECT
The method's cognitive complexity is still about 17, above the threshold of 15: for (+1), opening-bracket `if` (+2), nested constructor `if` with `&&` (+4), the new `else` (+1), closing-bracket `if` (+2), the `&&` moved into the `decorated &=` expression (+1), the unchanged `if` in the elided lines (+2), the `;` `if` (+2), and two `else if`s (+1 each); the behaviour itself looks equivalent.
